episodes.synopsis: Nakamura Teruaki has moved south to Okinawa from Tokyo and fallen in love with a local girl. There's just one problem, though: her Okinawan dialect is so thick that he can't understand a word she says!
episodes.title: The Girl I Like Speaks in Uchinaaguchi

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki is excited for the big class beach party, but he's the only one who wants to swim?!
episodes.title: A Beach Party Is Just a Social Gathering?!

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki learns more about Okinawan traditions, goes to a festival...and sneaks off somewhere "naughty"?!
episodes.title: Shiisaa and Eisaa

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki learns to whistle, and how the Okinawans dance.
episodes.title: Blow Your Finger Whistle at the Beautiful Sea!

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki tries on what he thinks is just a Hawaiian shirt, and discovers it has a deeper history than he imagines.
episodes.title: Kariyushi Wear by Mistake!

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki learns the history of Okinawan soba, and a typhoon closes in.
episodes.title: I Want to Cry "Okinawa Soba"!

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki learns the sorrowful tale of the time mongooses were brought to Okinawa.
episodes.title: Vipers and Mongooses

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki discovers that there are no trains in Okinawa.
episodes.title: Yui Rail Rides to the Music!

episodes.synopsis: Kyan tells Suzu the story of the Iriomote cat and its ancient history.
episodes.title: Amazing! The Iriomote Cat!

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki takes Higa on a test of courage and is shocked by what he finds.
episodes.title: The True Identity of the Yaaruu?!

episodes.synopsis: Teruaki learns the truth about goya and gooyaa.
episodes.title: Goya? Gooyaa?

episodes.synopsis: Kyan panics when she finds out that Teruaki likes her.
episodes.title: Anshee Matayaa! (See You Again Sometime!)
